title: Universal Topology Refinement for Medical Image Segmentation with Polynomial Feature Synthesis
mechanism: A model-agnostic topology refiner trained on synthetic perturbation masks generated from random orthogonal-polynomial fields, so the error distribution is not limited by a small labelled set or one network's biases.
adaptation: Generate polynomial perturbations on every crack label available (478 train, E-SCDD train cells, UCF-EL thin parts used label-only); use as the synthetic error source for the refiner in the Chen 2024 arm; compare error models.
min_experiment: Arm: refiner trained with polynomial perturbations. Baseline: house ensemble, and the morphological-error refiner. Metric: 5-fold CV components found, relF1@2, crack IoU. Kill: no gain > +0.005 relF1@2 over the house ensemble.
evidence: R: outperformed topology-driven losses and post-processing methods on medical segmentation; designed for small datasets (numbers not read).
